grades.reason: This is LoongArch pseudocode for LD.WU, not for LD.B or LD.BU. It shows that unsigned loads zero-extend the loaded value to GRLEN, which is the unsigned half of the comparison. It never covers the signed byte load or the top-bit case, so it helps only by analogy.
This xv6 RISC-V passage on context switching has nothing to do with LoongArch byte loads or extension behavior.
